item.text:
**4B.7 Research Note**
Overall reading: strongly negative. I found some narrow crisis-response positives for refugees and disaster survivors, but nothing that looks like a genuine effort to protect political equality for minorities, women, excluded groups, opposition regions, or unpopular viewpoints.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive, narrow | [Turkey completes new homes in area hit by devastating earthquake](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-completes-new-homes-in-area-hit-by-devastating-earthquake-3291916) | Reuters | 2024-02-03 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-completes-new-homes-in-area-hit-by-devastating-earthquake-3291916 | Erdoğan’s government handed over 7,275 homes to earthquake survivors in Hatay and promised more. This is concrete harm reduction for a badly affected region, but it is disaster relief rather than a broader equality policy. | 4B.7; 3B.9 |
| Positive, narrow | [Turkey detains 474 people after anti-Syrian riots: Minister](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/2/protests-and-arrests-as-anti-syrian-riots-rock-turkey) | Al Jazeera / Reuters | 2024-07-02 | https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/2/protests-and-arrests-as-anti-syrian-riots-rock-turkey | Erdoğan and Interior Minister Yerlikaya condemned anti-Syrian violence as unacceptable, and police detained hundreds after mob attacks on Syrians. This is a real response to xenophobic violence, though it is reactive and not evidence of broader equal treatment. | 4B.7; 3B.9 |
| Positive, narrow | [Turkey to work for Syrian migrants to return home safely, minister says](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-to-work-for-syrian-migrants-to-return-home-safely-minister-says-3760765) | Reuters | 2024-12-09 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkey-to-work-for-syrian-migrants-to-return-home-safely-minister-says-3760765 | Turkey said it would open the Yayladagi border gate to manage safe, voluntary return and prevent congestion after Assad’s fall. That is a limited protective response for displaced Syrians, not a general equality commitment. | 4B.7; 3B.9 |
| Negative | [Turkey: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says AKP politics favored Sunni Muslims, Kurdish parties faced harassment, women and LGBT people remained politically marginalized, and refugees faced severe restrictions and anti-foreigner rhetoric. This is direct evidence against political equality. | 4B.7; 4B.2; 4B.3; 4B.5 |
| Negative | [World Report 2024: Türkiye](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey | HRW says Erdoğan’s government used divisive anti-opposition discourse, including a fake PKK-linked video against CHP leader Kılıçdaroğlu, while Kurdish politicians and activists faced politically motivated prosecutions and prison terms for nonviolent activity. That is strong evidence against equal treatment of unpopular political viewpoints and Kurdish constituencies. | 4B.7; 4B.2; 4B.4; 4B.5 |
| Negative | [World Report 2024: Türkiye](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey | HRW says women and girls still faced ineffective protection from domestic violence after Turkey’s withdrawal from the Istanbul Convention, while anti-LGBT hate speech was a core part of the election campaign and Pride events were repeatedly banned with arrests. That is direct evidence against equality for women and LGBT people. | 4B.7; 4B.3; 4B.5 |

**Search gap**
I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Erdoğan pursued a broad equality agenda for minorities, women, refugees, or opposition regions. The positives are mostly narrow crisis responses, while the structural record remains discriminatory and exclusionary.
